text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.04.10-rc1 -> production (canary 8% us-west). Post-deploy mini-smoke started: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3500012345

sara: qa-bot flagged short-generate probes returning 204 with empty body (probe gen-smoke-7). p95 ok but 9/50 probes empty.

josh: likely related to the new cache-prefetch fast-path we enabled in rc1. If that path returns early with nil, pipeline might close stream.

qa-bot: Metric smoke.synthetic_empty_body{region="us-west",route="/generate"} crossed 3% at 2026-04-10T11:12:02Z.

infra-bot: kv-warmup job for us-west finished ~4m before rollout; autoscaler log shows 2 nodes recycled during deployment window.

sara: mitigation options: 1) rollback/reroll canary 2) pin us-west generate-route to stable 3) hotfix: add explicit fallback-to-fill in pipeline.

josh: pin region to stable to reduce blast radius. We can test hotfix in staging then re-ramp.

ops-oncall: approving regional pin. Please execute pin and increase probe sampling to 200/5m for observability.

infra-bot: Applied: `pin-route --region us-west --route /generate --target v2026.04.08-stable --reason "synthetic empty responses on cache-prefetch path"` 1s ago. Sampling updated.

sara: creating RD-4900 and updating release notes: "us-west generate-route temporarily pinned to v2026.04.08-stable after synthetic probes detected empty responses on cache-prefetch fast-path; rollout paused for us-west."

josh: I'll reproduce with injected warmup miss and post logs. If hotfix small, we may ship patch and unpin same-day.

ops-oncall: change window: hold ramp until 12:00 UTC or until RD-4900 triage complete (owner: josh).

sara: keeping thread open. will post sample numbers in 10m.

qa-bot: boosted sample result: 200 probes -> 26 empties (13%).

josh: confirming reproduction locally, will propose fallback flag PR.

ops-oncall: thanks team :thumbsup:
